name: normalizeUrl
requirements: Accept a URL string as input
Normalize scheme and host to lowercase
Remove default ports (80 for http, 443 for https)
Sort query parameters alphabetically by key
Handle percent-encoding according to RFC 3986 (ISO/IEC 3986 equivalent)
Remove trailing slashes from the path (unless it is the root)
Resolve dot-segments (. and ..) in the path
edge_cases: URLs with trailing dots in hostname
